title: Scenario-tiered investment asks and decision ladder for QBR
creator: Asha Patel
description: Purpose: Prepare a concise, scenario-based set of investment asks for the upcoming QBR that maps funding tiers to concrete deliverables, risk tradeoffs, and measurable OKR outcomes. This ticket produces the single-slide commitment matrix, a 3-lane decision ladder (Protect / Maintain / Accelerate), and an annotated script for the exec readout. Background: Leadership requested clearer options for converting platform usage signals into near-term capacity and product investments (Hosted API slots, Dedicated capacity, Private onboarding workstreams). We need to translate Q1 telemetry, cost-per-token trends, and customer signals into 3 credible investment scenarios with associated asks and rollback gates.
acceptance_criteria: One-page commitment matrix (low/medium/high investment) that maps to: scope, expected impact on OKRs, cost delta, 2-week and 90-day milestones
Decision ladder with explicit rollback and evaluation gates for each scenario (SLOs, cost thresholds, customer onboarding metrics)
Annotated speaker notes (<= 500 words) and 4 supporting backup slides for exec Q&A
Reviewed and agreed by Eng lead (runtime), Head of Sales (top customer asks), and Finance (cost delta validated)
Stakeholder signoffs captured in comments and Confluence links
decisions_needed: Which investment scenario will be recommended as the default ask (team recommends Medium)
Whether to include a hard cap on Dedicated capacity spend for Medium scenario
Approve the proposed evaluation gates and rollback thresholds for each scenario
